name: speak
description: Speak dialogue aloud in the scene — visible to all present characters and the player.

name: emote
description: Perform a physical action or express an emotion visible to others in the scene.

name: move
description: Move the character to a new location or position within the current scene.

name: set_activity
description: Declare the character's current activity or idle behaviour for ambient scene context.

name: ask_player
description: Pose a direct question or prompt to the player character, requesting a response.

name: remember_private
description: Write a private memory entry to the character's MEMORY.md — not visible to other characters.

name: remember_public
description: Record a shared memory or observable fact into the instance event log.

name: update_relationship
description: Update the character's public relationship standing with another entity in the instance event log.

name: set_intention
description: Set or revise the character's private goal or intention for the current story arc.

name: revise_belief
description: Update a private belief the character holds based on new information encountered this wake.

name: surface_lead
description: Surface a story lead or hook that may be pursued by the player or other characters.

name: create_rumor
description: Introduce a rumor into the scene that can spread through the instance's social fabric.

name: propose_fact
description: GM-only: assert a world fact into the instance event log for other characters to treat as true.

name: record_consequence
description: GM-only: record a story consequence that will affect the world state or character arcs.

name: request_scene_shift
description: Request a transition to a different scene or location — subject to GM approval.

name: reject_claim
description: Validator-only: reject a claim made by a character as inconsistent with established facts.

name: deflect
description: Deflect a question or action without committing to a response — produces no persistent state.

name: wake_done
description: Signal that the character's wake is complete and no further tool calls will be made.

name: wake_abort
description: Abort the current wake abnormally — used when an unrecoverable error prevents normal completion.
